page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.4xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 16 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) mapped to 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. No local storage is bundled with this instance, and it lacks dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate that the ecs.sn1ne.4xlarge delivers moderate multi-core compute capabilities alongside weaker single-core performance. Single-core tests, such as stress-ng and Geekbench single-core, place the instance in the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively, reflecting the older architecture of the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor. However, multi-core benchmarks, including stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU tests, consistently rank in the middle 50% tier. Memory bandwidth performance remains average across both small and large block read/write operations, though PassMark memory scores fall into the weak category. The instance shows average throughput for static web serving, Redis SET operations, and software compilation tasks.

Given its hardware profile, the ecs.sn1ne.4xlarge offers a balanced, cost-efficient option for multi-threaded workloads that do not require high single-core performance or massive memory footprints. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it suitable for compute-heavy tasks such as multi-threaded decompression, image processing, ray tracing, and moderate database operations. However, the lack of local storage and lower single-threaded efficiency represent key tradeoffs. It is best suited for workloads like web serving, software compilation, and light multi-threaded application hosting.
